title: O24 — Finding a point on an elliptic curve
exact_target: Can one deterministically find finite coordinates of a point on the given nonsingular elliptic curve in polynomial time?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 8400028 (AMR-083-0028). CC BY 4.0.
